    Enter Terminal

    Questions, answered.

    What is a dry port?

    An inland container terminal linked to a seaport by rail or road. It clears cargo away from the coast and keeps the seaport moving.

    What does the optimizer do?

    It scores every free slot and picks the one that blocks the fewest containers, so later pickups need fewer extra crane moves.

    Can a container leave without customs clearance?

    No. Release is blocked until customs is cleared and storage dues are paid.

    Who can use SmartPort?

    Five roles: Admin, Gate Officer, Yard Supervisor, Documentation Clerk and Billing Clerk. Each one sees only the pages they need.

    Is this real data?

    No. This is a frontend demo with sample data. Accounts and changes reset when the page reloads.
